tests.description: Verify plan-mapped criterion: A user can choose a Hugging Face model card and pin a commit revision.
Verify plan-mapped criterion: The selected model is registered as MLModel and MLModelVersion with source, license, task, format, and runtime requirements.
Verify plan-mapped criterion: Artifacts and hashes are resolved and optionally mirrored to Blossom and/or OCI with provenance edges.
Verify plan-mapped criterion: Placement selects a worker advertising vLLM, safetensors or Hugging Face snapshot support, NVIDIA CUDA, and enough VRAM.

Verify plan-mapped criterion: The model deploys to vLLM, exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint through the existing gateway path, publishes deployment status/result and 31986 endpoint state, and records smoke evaluation/provenance edges.
